captures.note: Every one of the five category URLs at src/adapters/jobgether.ts:6-12 answers HTTP 410 Gone. The body is the site's search page, whose canonical link names the replacement.

The first three records of the JSON endpoint jobgether's own robots.txt explicitly allows (Allow: /astroapi/ai/jobs.json). It carries title, company, url, location, contract type and salary range - which is what the 410'd category pages were being scraped for. Input for the repair, not a repair.
